newsitem.title: USA: Morrison wins $77 mln CalTrans contract.
newsitem.headline: Morrison wins $77 mln CalTrans contract.

text.p: Morrison Knudsen Corp said Monday it has won two contracts worth about $77 million to perform highway expansion projects in California.

The contracts were awarded by the California Department of Transportation and include a $51 million award to add car pool lanes along five miles of Interstate 10 in western San Bernardino County and a $26.6 million contract to add two lanes to a section of State Highway 41 in Fresno.
The company said in a statement construction on both projects will begin immediately. The Fresno project is to be compled in May of 1998 and the San Bernardino project will be finished in late 1999.
